recipes.name: Gyudon
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef simmered in sweet soy-dashi broth piled over steaming rice - Japan's beloved fast bowl.

steps.instruction: Simmer onion in dashi until translucent; season with soy, mirin, sake and sugar.
Add beef slices; simmer 5 minutes skimming foam.
Pile beef and onions over hot rice with plenty of broth.
Top with pickled red ginger or a raw egg yolk if desired.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Gyudon (Japanese Beef Rice Bowl Recipe)

recipes.name: Sukiyaki
recipes.description: Communal hotpot of marbled beef, tofu, noodles and vegetables sweetened with warishita soy-mirin broth.

steps.instruction: Heat tallow in a wide pot; sear a few beef slices and sprinkle sugar.
Add warishita, then arrange cabbage, tofu, mushrooms and noodles.
Simmer covered 8-10 minutes, adding remaining beef on top to cook briefly.
Dip ingredients in raw beaten egg as you eat, Japanese-style.

videos.videoTitle: Ultimate Homemade Sukiyaki Guide (Japanese Recipe From Scratch)

recipes.name: Nikujaga
recipes.description: Meat-and-potato stew simmered in sweet soy-dashi - the soul of Japanese home cooking.

steps.instruction: Brown beef briefly; add onion, then potatoes and carrot.
Pour in dashi with soy, mirin and sake.
Simmer covered with a drop-lid (otoshi-buta) 25-30 minutes.
Uncover to reduce until liquid is nearly gone.

videos.videoTitle: Experience True Japanese Flavors: "Nikujaga" Cooking Tutorial!

recipes.name: Beef Korokke
recipes.description: Crisp panko croquettes of savory minced beef and potato - bakery-counter royalty across Japan.

steps.instruction: Brown beef and onion; season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Fold into mashed potatoes; cool completely.
Shape ovals; flour, egg and panko each one.
Deep-fry at 170°C until deep golden; serve with tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Tataki
recipes.description: Seared beef sliced thin and served with ponzu, grated daikon, and scallions

steps.instruction: Sear beef tenderloin on all sides over high heat until browned but rare inside
Let rest briefly then slice thinly against the grain
Serve topped with grated daikon, scallions, sesame seeds, and ponzu sauce

videos.videoTitle: The secret to perfect beef tataki | Simple recipe with garlic chips & ponzu

recipes.name: Hambagu
recipes.description: Juicy Japanese-style beef patty glazed with demi-glace and served with rice

steps.instruction: Saute minced onion until soft, then cool and mix with beef, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, and soy sauce
Form into oval patties and cook in a skillet over medium heat until browned on both sides
Glaze with a mixture of Worcestershire sauce and ketchup and serve with steamed rice and vegetables

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Hambagu (Japanese Hamburger Steak) (Recipe) ハンバーグの作り方 (レシピ)

recipes.name: Beef Nikomi
recipes.description: Dashi-simmered beef chunks with daikon and burdock in a savory broth

steps.instruction: Cut beef into chunks and parboil to remove excess fat
Cut daikon, carrot, and burdock into pieces and add to pot with konnyaku and dashi stock
Simmer with soy sauce, sake, and mirin until beef is fork-tender and vegetables have absorbed the broth

recipes.name: Yakiniku
recipes.description: Grilled beef slices with a sweet soy sesame marinade served with rice and vegetables

steps.instruction: Marinate beef slices in soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, and ginger for 30 minutes
Grill beef over high heat in batches until charred and cooked to desired doneness
Serve grilled beef in lettuce leaves with scallions and steamed rice

recipes.name: Beef Shogayaki
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef grilled with a ginger soy glaze, served with shredded cabbage

steps.instruction: Mix grated ginger, soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar to make the shogayaki marinade
Marinate beef slices for 15 minutes then cook in a hot skillet until browned
Serve immediately over rice with a side of shredded cabbage

recipes.name: Gyu-Nabe
recipes.description: Beef and vegetable hot pot with tofu in a rich soy dashi broth

steps.instruction: Bring dashi stock to a simmer and season with soy sauce and mirin in a large pot
Arrange vegetables, tofu, shirataki, and mushrooms around the pot and simmer until tender
Add beef slices and cook briefly, then serve with ponzu or sesame dipping sauce

recipes.name: Gyu no Tsukudani
recipes.description: Beef simmered in sweet soy sauce until rich and tender, served over steamed rice

steps.instruction: Cut beef into bite-sized pieces and blanch to remove scum
Combine soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, and ginger in a pot and bring to a boil
Add beef and simmer gently until the liquid reduces to a thick glaze coating the meat

recipes.name: Beef Tofu
recipes.description: Braised beef and soft tofu in a savory miso soy broth with scallions

steps.instruction: Brown beef slices in a pot with grated ginger until no longer pink
Add dashi stock, soy sauce, miso, sake, and mirin and bring to a gentle simmer
Add cubed tofu and simmer for ten minutes, then garnish with sliced scallions

recipes.name: Kimchi Nikujaga
recipes.description: Spicy variation of the classic beef and potato stew with kimchi and gochujang

steps.instruction: Parboil and chunk potatoes and carrots
Simmer beef and kimchi in dashi with gochujang, soy sauce, and mirin
Add potatoes, carrots, and shirataki and cook until everything is tender and flavors have melded

recipes.name: Negi Maki
recipes.description: Thin beef slices rolled around green onion and grilled with a sweet soy glaze

steps.instruction: Cut green onion into 10cm lengths
Roll each piece of green onion with a slice of beef and secure with a toothpick
Grill or pan-sear until beef is browned, then brush with a mixture of soy sauce, mirin, and sugar

recipes.name: Gyu Hire
recipes.description: Grilled beef tenderloin seasoned with salt and served with wasabi and soy

steps.instruction: Season beef tenderloin generously with salt and pepper and let rest at room temperature
Grill over high heat to desired doneness, turning once
Slice and serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and a squeeze of lemon

recipes.name: Gyu Kare
recipes.description: Japanese-style beef curry with potatoes and carrots served over steamed rice

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes in a pot, then add diced onion, potato, and carrot and cook for a few minutes
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until beef and vegetables are tender
Break curry roux into the pot and stir until dissolved and thickened, then serve over steamed rice

recipes.name: Beef Nikujaga Extra
recipes.description: Classic beef and potato simmered stew with shirataki

steps.instruction: Brown beef slices and sliced onion in a pot.
Add potatoes shirataki dashi and seasonings.
Simmer covered until potatoes are tender and liquid reduces.

recipes.name: Gyu Sukiyaki Extra
recipes.description: Sweet soy hotpot with beef tofu and vegetables

steps.instruction: Sear beef slices in a hot sukiyaki pan with sugar.
Add dashi soy sauce and mirin to create broth.
Add vegetables tofu and shirataki simmer until cooked.

recipes.name: Yakiniku Extra
recipes.description: Japanese BBQ beef with dipping tare sauce

steps.instruction: Slice beef thinly and arrange on a plate.
Mix soy sauce mirin sugar sesame oil and garlic for tare.
Grill beef over high heat dip in tare and serve.

recipes.name: Kokoro Nikomi
recipes.description: Hearty beef tendon and tripe stew in rich miso

steps.instruction: Braise tendon and tripe in dashi until very tender.
Add daikon and carrot simmer until soft.
Dissolve miso into broth and serve in a deep bowl with green onion.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Don
recipes.description: Glossy pan-glazed chicken thigh over steamed rice with edamame and toasted sesame - a Japanese weeknight staple.

steps.instruction: Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar into a teriyaki glaze.
Pan-fry chicken thighs skin-side down until deeply golden; flip and cook through.
Pour off excess fat, add glaze and reduce until it lacquers the chicken.
Slice chicken; serve over hot rice with edamame and sesame seeds.

videos.videoTitle: Japanese Chicken Teriyaki Don Recipe - Easy And Quick

recipes.name: Oyakodon
recipes.description: 'Parent-and-child' bowl: chicken and egg softly set over rice in sweet soy-dashi broth.

steps.instruction: Simmer onion in dashi, soy and mirin until soft; add chicken and poach through.
Pour beaten egg evenly over; cover and cook just until softly set.
Slide half the mixture over each bowl of hot rice.
Scatter herbs and serve immediately.

videos.videoTitle: Perfect Oyakodon Recipe (The Ultimate Japanese Chicken & Egg Rice Bowl)

recipes.name: Karaage
recipes.description: Twice-fried Japanese fried chicken marinated in ginger-soy - crackly outside, juicy inside.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in soy, sake, ginger and garlic for 1 hour.
Toss pieces in potato starch just before frying.
Fry at 160°C for 4 minutes; rest, then fry again at 190°C for 1-2 minutes.
Drain and serve with lemon and mayo if liked.

recipes.name: Yakitori
recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled chicken skewers glazed with tare sauce - izakaya nightlife in finger food form.

steps.instruction: Simmer soy, mirin, sake and sugar into a glossy tare glaze.
Thread chicken onto skewers, folding skin between pieces.
Grill over medium charcoal, turning and brushing tare repeatedly.
Cook 10-12 minutes until lacquered and charred at edges.

recipes.name: Chicken Nanban
recipes.description: Crispy chicken served with a sweet vinegar nanban sauce and creamy tartar topping

steps.instruction: Coat chicken thigh in flour and beaten egg, then cook in oil until golden and crispy
Mix rice vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar for the nanban sauce and pour over hot chicken
Top with a mixture of mayonnaise and diced cucumber and serve with shredded cabbage

recipes.name: Tebasaki
recipes.description: Glazed chicken wings with a sweet soy and pepper coating served as an appetizer

steps.instruction: Simmer chicken wings in water with garlic and ginger to remove scum, then drain
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a pan and bring to a boil
Add wings and cook, turning frequently, until the glaze is thick and sticky, then sprinkle with pepper and sesame

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu
recipes.description: Crispy panko-crusted chicken cutlet served with tonkatsu sauce and shredded cabbage

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breast to even thickness, then coat in flour, beaten egg, and panko
Deep fry in oil at 170 degrees until golden brown and cooked through
Slice and serve with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and a lemon wedge

recipes.name: Tori Nabe
recipes.description: Chicken hot pot with napa cabbage, mushrooms, and tofu in a light dashi broth

steps.instruction: Bring dashi stock to a simmer and season with soy sauce, mirin, and sake
Arrange cabbage, mushrooms, tofu, and leek in the pot and simmer until tender
Add chicken slices and cook through, then serve with ponzu dipping sauce

recipes.name: Mizutaki
recipes.description: Chicken and vegetable stew simmered in a rich dashi broth with sesame dipping sauce

steps.instruction: Parboil chicken drumsticks to remove scum and set aside
Bring dashi to a simmer, add daikon, carrots, and chicken, and simmer until tender
Add cabbage, mushrooms, and tofu, cook briefly, and serve with sesame paste dipping sauce

recipes.name: Negima Chicken
recipes.description: Skewered chicken thigh and green onion grilled with a sweet soy glaze

steps.instruction: Alternate chicken thigh cubes and green onion pieces on bamboo skewers
Grill over medium-high heat, turning frequently to cook evenly
Brush with a glaze of soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar during the last few minutes of grilling

recipes.name: Chicken Tatsuta
recipes.description: Marinated chicken thigh coated in potato starch and deep-fried until crispy

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, sake, and grated ginger for at least 30 minutes
Coat each piece generously with potato starch, shaking off excess
Deep fry in oil at 170 degrees until golden and crispy, drain, and serve with lemon and shichimi

recipes.name: Doro Meshi
recipes.description: Clay pot chicken and rice cooked together with ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil

steps.instruction: Wash rice and place in a clay pot with water, soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil
Top with diced chicken, mushrooms, and grated ginger
Cover and cook over medium-low heat until rice is fluffy and chicken is cooked through, garnish with scallions

recipes.name: Soboro Don
recipes.description: Seasoned ground chicken served over rice with scrambled egg and pickled vegetables

steps.instruction: Cook ground chicken in a pan with soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar, breaking into fine crumbles
Scramble eggs softly in a separate pan until just set
Serve chicken soboro and scrambled egg over steamed rice with pickled vegetables and scallions

recipes.name: Tori Sumibi
recipes.description: Charcoal-grilled chicken thigh marinated in soy and mirin, served with scallion

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken thigh in soy sauce, mirin, sake, garlic, and ginger for at least one hour
Grill over high heat until charred on the outside and cooked through
Serve with steamed rice and garnish with sliced scallions

recipes.name: Tori Dango
recipes.description: Seasoned chicken dumplings served in a light dashi broth with scallions

steps.instruction: Mix ground chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, ginger, and soy sauce, then form into small balls
Bring dashi stock to a simmer and season with soy sauce and mirin
Drop chicken balls into the broth and simmer until cooked through, then garnish with scallions

recipes.name: Tori Den
recipes.description: Chicken meatballs simmered in a sweet soy broth with grated daikon on the side

steps.instruction: Mix ground chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, and ginger, then form into oval-shaped meatballs
Brown meatballs lightly in a pan, then add dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar
Simmer until the sauce reduces and coats the meatballs, serve with grated daikon

recipes.name: Chicken Hiyashi
recipes.description: Chilled poached chicken breast served with a ginger soy dressing and cucumber

steps.instruction: Poach chicken breast gently in water with ginger slices until cooked through, then chill in ice water
Shred chilled chicken into bite-sized strips
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar for dressing, then toss chicken with dressing, cucumber, and scallions

recipes.name: Tori Meshi
recipes.description: Chicken and rice cooked together in dashi with shiitake mushrooms and carrot

steps.instruction: Wash rice and place in a pot with dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sake
Top with diced chicken, sliced shiitake, and carrot
Cover and cook over medium-low heat until rice absorbs all liquid and chicken is cooked through, garnish with scallions

recipes.name: Yakitori Extra
recipes.description: Grilled chicken skewers with tare glaze

steps.instruction: Thread chicken and green onion onto bamboo skewers.
Grill over charcoal while basting with tare.
Cook until charred and glazed serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu Extra
recipes.description: Japanese breaded chicken cutlet with tonkatsu sauce

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breast and season with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour egg and panko breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry until golden slice and serve with tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.name: Nasu Dengaku
recipes.description: Miso-glazed eggplant halves broiled until the sweet-salty glaze caramelizes.

steps.instruction: Pan-fry eggplant cut-side down in oil until deeply browned; flip and soften.
Simmer miso, mirin, sake and sugar into thick dengaku glaze.
Spread glaze thickly over the cut faces.
Broil 2-3 minutes until bubbling; finish with sesame.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Nasu dengaku. Japanese traditional Miso Eggplant dish!

recipes.name: Agedashi Tofu
recipes.description: Silken tofu in a delicate katakuriko crust floating in hot tsuyu with grated daikon and ginger.

steps.instruction: Press tofu 15 minutes; pat very dry.
Coat cubes generously in potato starch.
Deep-fry at 175°C about 3 minutes until light gold; drain.
Serve in warm tsuyu (dashi + soy + mirin) topped with daikon, ginger, spring onion.

videos.videoTitle: Make Easy & Delicious Agedashi Tofu (Fried Tofu)! Enjoyed With the Sauce Full of Umami!

recipes.name: Vegetable Tempura
recipes.description: Feather-light ice-cold batter around sweet potato, shiso, lotus root and seasonal vegetables.

steps.instruction: Whisk yolk with icy water; fold in flour with chopsticks, leaving lumps.
Dip vegetables and fry small batches at 175°C until pale gold.
Drain upright on a rack; season lightly with fine salt.
Serve immediately with tentsuyu.

recipes.name: Yasai Yakisoba
recipes.description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with cabbage, bean sprouts and yakisoba sauce - festival-night comfort.

steps.instruction: Stir-fry harder vegetables first in hot oil, then cabbage and sprouts.
Add noodles with a splash of water, loosening as they heat.
Pour in yakisoba sauce; toss until every strand is coated.
Finish with beni shoga and aonori flakes.

recipes.name: Horenso Goma
recipes.description: Blanched spinach dressed with a savory sesame paste sauce and topped with sesame seeds

steps.instruction: Blanch spinach in salted boiling water for 30 seconds, then transfer to ice water and squeeze dry
Mix sesame paste, soy sauce, sugar, and a splash of water to make the dressing
Dress spinach with the sesame sauce and top with toasted sesame seeds

recipes.name: Shira-ae
recipes.description: Tofu-dressed salad of blanched vegetables including green beans and carrots

steps.instruction: Press tofu to remove excess moisture, then mash until smooth
Blanch green beans and sliced carrots until tender-crisp and drain well
Mix mashed tofu with sesame paste, soy sauce, and sugar, then toss with the vegetables and top with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Kinpira Gobo
recipes.description: Burdock root and carrot julienned and sauteed in soy sauce and sesame

steps.instruction: Julienne burdock root and carrot into thin matchsticks, soak burdock in water to remove bitterness
Heat sesame oil in a pan with dried chili and stir-fry burdock and carrot until tender
Season with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, cook until liquid evaporates, and garnish with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Yasai Itame
recipes.description: Stir-fried mixed vegetables with bean sprouts in a savory soy sauce seasoning

steps.instruction: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan over high heat with garlic
Add carrots, cabbage, and mushrooms and stir-fry until slightly softened
Add bean sprouts and soy sauce, toss quickly until just heated through, season with salt

recipes.name: Hiyayakko
recipes.description: Chilled silken tofu topped with ginger, scallions, sesame seeds, and soy sauce

steps.instruction: Chill silken tofu in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
Cut into blocks and place on a plate
Top with grated ginger, sliced scallions, sesame seeds, shichimi, and drizzle with soy sauce

recipes.name: Nasu Miso
recipes.description: Eggplant chunks braised in a rich miso and dashi broth until meltingly tender

steps.instruction: Cut eggplant into chunks and fry in sesame oil until browned on all sides
Add dashi stock, miso paste, mirin, and sugar to the pan and stir to combine
Simmer until eggplant is very tender and the sauce has thickened, garnish with scallions

recipes.name: Vegetable Nikujaga
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable stew with potatoes, shirataki, and mushrooms in dashi broth

steps.instruction: Parboil potatoes and carrots, then cut into chunks
Simmer shirataki, konnyaku, and mushrooms in dashi with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar
Add potatoes and carrots and simmer until tender and the broth has reduced slightly

recipes.name: Hijiki Nimono
recipes.description: Hijiki seaweed simmered with carrots, aburaage, and soy sauce in dashi

steps.instruction: Soak dried hijiki in water for 30 minutes, then drain
Julienne carrots and cut aburaage into strips, then place in a pot with dashi
Add hijiki, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, and simmer until the liquid is nearly absorbed

recipes.name: Kanroni
recipes.description: Sweet soy braised daikon radish until tender and translucent, served as a side

steps.instruction: Peel daikon and cut into thick rounds, then parboil in water with a little rice to remove bitterness
Place daikon in a pot with dashi stock, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar
Simmer gently until daikon is translucent and has absorbed the sweet soy broth, garnish with scallions

recipes.name: Kabocha Ni
recipes.description: Sweet simmered kabocha squash in dashi with soy sauce and mirin

steps.instruction: Cut kabocha into wedges and remove seeds
Place in a pot with dashi stock, sugar, and salt, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer
Add soy sauce and mirin and cook until kabocha is tender but still holds its shape

recipes.name: Takuan
recipes.description: Sun-dried daikon pickled in rice bran and salt, served as a crunchy side

steps.instruction: Salt daikon radish and weight it down for one day to draw out moisture
Mix rice bran with water, salt, chili, and kombu to make the pickling bed
Bury daikon in the rice bran mixture and ferment in a cool dark place for at least one week

videos.videoTitle: たくあんの作り方（漬け方） - How to make Takuwan (Japanese Radish Pickles)

recipes.name: Ohitashi
recipes.description: Blanched spinach seasoned with dashi, soy sauce, and topped with sesame seeds

steps.instruction: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, then shock in ice water and squeeze dry
Mix dashi stock, soy sauce, and mirin for the seasoning
Toss spinach with the seasoning and serve topped with toasted sesame seeds

recipes.name: Yasai Goroke
recipes.description: Vegetable croquettes with mashed potato and mixed vegetables coated in panko

steps.instruction: Boil and mash potatoes, mix with cooked diced carrot, corn, and sauteed onion, season with salt
Shape into oval patties, coat in flour, dip in beaten egg, then roll in panko
Deep fry in oil at 170 degrees until golden and crispy, serve with tonkatsu sauce

recipes.name: Goma Ae
recipes.description: Sesame dressed blanched vegetables including green beans and carrots

steps.instruction: Blanch green beans and julienned carrots until tender-crisp, then drain and cool
Grind sesame seeds and mix with soy sauce, sugar, and mirin to make the dressing
Toss vegetables with the sesame dressing until evenly coated and serve

recipes.name: Edamame Miso
recipes.description: Steamed edamame tossed with white miso butter

steps.instruction: Steam edamame in pods until just tender.
Melt butter with miso until smooth.
Toss hot edamame with miso butter and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Gyu Sashi
recipes.description: Thinly sliced beef sashimi with ponzu and garlic

steps.instruction: Slice beef paper-thin against the grain.
Arrange on chilled plate with grated daikon and shiso.
Serve with ponzu sliced garlic and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Matcha Mochi
recipes.description: Chewy rice cakes dusted in matcha sugar - springtime sweetness in two bites.

steps.instruction: Whisk shiratamako, sugar, matcha and water into a smooth slurry.
Microwave 1 minute, stir, repeat in 30-second bursts until translucent.
Turn onto starch-dusted tray; cool slightly.
Portion with a starch-coated knife; dust with matcha-sugar.

recipes.name: Dorayaki
recipes.description: Fluffy honey pancakes sandwiched with sweet azuki bean paste - Doraemon's favorite.

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with sugar and honey until thick; whisk in water.
Fold in flour and baking powder; rest batter 15 minutes.
Cook 9cm rounds in a dry pan until bubbles set the top; flip briefly.
Sandwich generous anko between two pancakes.

recipes.name: Dango
recipes.description: Chewy rice dumplings on skewers glazed with sweet soy or red bean paste

steps.instruction: Mix shiratamako with water to form a smooth dough, then shape into small round dumplings
Boil dumplings in water until they float, then transfer to ice water
Thread onto skewers and brush with a mixture of soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, or serve with red bean paste

recipes.name: Yokan
recipes.description: Firm sweet red bean jelly set with agar and sliced into elegant blocks

steps.instruction: Dissolve agar powder in water and bring to a boil, stirring until fully dissolved
Add red bean paste, sugar, and salt, and stir until smooth and well combined
Pour into a mold and refrigerate until firm, then slice into blocks and serve

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Mizu-Yokan (Japanese Soft Azuki Bean Jelly) Recipe 水ようかんの作り方 (和菓子レシピ)

recipes.name: Castella
recipes.description: Light and airy Japanese sponge cake with a golden crust and moist crumb

steps.instruction: Whisk eggs and sugar until thick and pale, then gently fold in sifted flour
Add honey, mirin, and milk and fold until just combined without deflating the batter
Pour into a lined rectangular pan and bake at 170 degrees for 35 minutes, then cool and slice

recipes.name: Monaka
recipes.description: Crispy wafer shells filled with sweet red bean paste and shaped into elegant forms

steps.instruction: Place a spoonful of red bean paste on one wafer shell
Add a piece of chestnut on top of the paste
Cover with another wafer shell and press gently to form the monaka

recipes.name: Ohagi
recipes.description: Sweet rice balls coated in red bean paste or kinako roasted soybean flour

steps.instruction: Cook glutinous rice with water until very soft, then pound lightly with a pestle
Form into small oval balls while still warm
Coat half in red bean paste and half in a mixture of kinako, sugar, and salt

recipes.name: Taiyaki
recipes.description: Fish-shaped pastry filled with sweet red bean paste, cooked until golden

steps.instruction: Whisk flour, egg, sugar, milk, and baking powder into a smooth batter
Heat a taiyaki mold and brush with oil, pour batter into each fish-shaped cavity
Add a spoonful of red bean paste, cover with more batter, and cook until golden on both sides

recipes.name: Suman
recipes.description: Steamed sweet rice cake wrapped in banana leaves with a hint of coconut

steps.instruction: Mix soaked glutinous rice with coconut milk, sugar, salt, and pandan leaves
Place portions of the rice mixture onto banana leaves and wrap into neat parcels
Steam for 30 to 40 minutes until the rice is translucent and fully cooked

recipes.name: Anmitsu
recipes.description: Agar jelly dessert with red bean and mochi

steps.instruction: Dissolve agar in water and set in a shallow tray.
Cut agar into cubes and place in a bowl.
Top with red bean paste mochi fruit and kuromitsu syrup.
